# Identity, revision and change

Candidate rule: statements should identify the subject and relevant revision/configuration, rather than treating an enduring name as proof of unchanged meaning or performance. Distinguish the thing, its description, revisions of that description and dated records of its operation.

Need, requirement, design, system configuration and evidence may change independently. A prior accepted assessment cannot automatically establish a later version's fulfillment. Dependencies should make affected conclusions discoverable when a source or assumption changes.

Proposed change questions: what changed; who had authority; when it was decided and took effect; what prior position it replaces; which requirements, designs and assessments require reconsideration; whether incorporation is complete. Detailed version identifiers and propagation mechanics remain open.

In this collection, decision filenames are stable descriptive slugs and dates are in metadata. A substantive reversal should preserve the earlier record and point to a successor rather than silently rewrite the decision. No standards release version was assigned during this capture.

## Accepted document identity and UUIDv7 format

The owner accepted an immutable identity for each maintained document, independent
of its path, title, classifications and ordinary edits. An exact reviewed version
also needs a revision reference. This is document identity, not the identity of
the concept discussed by the document. See the [decision](../../../source-locators.md#source-77fa788985a99f7b)
and [attributed discussion](../../../source-locators.md#source-18b0a93e906a5338).

The [format decision](../../../source-locators.md#source-022bfb6d6f17fb05) selects
[UUIDv7](../../../source-locators.md#source-f159f8295d5b8689), generated once when first assigning the
document its identity in the corpus. Its timestamp means corpus identity assignment
or record creation, not original authorship of an imported or pre-existing document.
Original authorship is separate provenance when relevant. Do not require a separate
`created_on` merely to duplicate that same derivable assignment timestamp.

The later [scoped metadata application](../../../source-locators.md#source-9d3e6d8f03badaef)
assigns UUIDv7 document IDs and exact dotted collection memberships to the current
project documents. Earlier decisions recorded the convention before that application.
An on-demand scan can locate an ID within a stated scope; no persistent resolver
or automatic relative-link repair is installed. Broader lookup policy, exact
revision representation and collection rename behavior remain open under EOM-12.

EOM-08 and EOM-12 in [the ledger](../../../source-locators.md#source-c43947fdcdae322a) own open change and representation work. See [records](../information-model/records-and-provenance.md).
